title: "Brotherly Destiny"
next_chapter_hook: "In the depths of the temporal-spatial rift, eyes long dormant slowly opened—Chapter 703, on the chessboard of fate, two pieces finally recognized each other."

text.content: "The observer's words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The phrase 'you brothers are both its pieces' sent a chill down his spine. He had thought Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect was merely fate's cruel joke, but now it seemed that from the very beginning, all three siblings had been observed by that unseen eye. The night wind outside the window wailed mournfully, ruffling his robes as if even the heavens were mocking his naivety."

dialogue.content: "Three pieces... What a masterful Eye of Heavenly Dao."

text.content: "Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly—not from fear, but because the anger long suppressed had finally found an outlet. He drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm—anger solved nothing. Only meticulous planning could rival that eye. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea flickered with a soft glow, as if sensing his changing state of mind, and began to operate on its own."

dialogue.content: "The guardian of the remnant soul spoke hauntingly, carrying a rare gravity: 'It finally couldn't hold back. Boy, your brother... is far more dangerous than he appears.'"

text.content: "At that moment, an strange resonance emanated from the depths of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—that was Blood Pulse resonance! A familiar scent that made his heart race pierced through layers of temporal-spatial barriers, flooding his perception like a tide. Ten years had passed. The figure whose features had blurred in his memory had now intersected with his divine consciousness."

"He 'saw' the scene deep within the temporal-spatial rift—amid chaotic torrents raging across the sky, a figure was bound by chain-like laws of power, surrounded by thunder and fire, yet still standing with an upright spine. It was Chen Tianming, his older brother, currently withstanding some indescribable horror through sheer flesh, each exchange causing the entire Void to tremble."

"Chen Ji's voice unconsciously grew hoarse. He remembered the scene of Chen Tianming carrying him through the deep mountains as a child, remembered that figure standing before the demon beast, drenched in blood yet refusing to retreat a single step. Ten years had worn many memories ragged, but the bond in the depths of their bloodline had never faded with time."

"In that moment of distraction, a voice directly penetrated his divine consciousness barrier, echoing through his Mental Sea—low, hoarse, yet carrying undeniable authority. 'Xiao Ji, ten years have passed. You've finally enabled that fragment to resonate with you.' It was Chen Tianming's voice! Chen Ji trembled violently. After ten years of separation, his brother actually remembered his childhood nickname."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji suppressed the surging emotions, his voice cold: 'Your intelligence network is impressive indeed. Knowing even about the Tianji Record Fragment shows you haven't been idle in that rift.'"

"Before the words finished, a scene forcibly flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—the scene from ten years ago, young Chen Tianming drenched in blood, eyes blazing as he stared at an invisible eye in the Void, screaming: 'I know you're watching! Exclude my brother and sister from your chess game, or I'll make sure you gain nothing!'"

text.content: "Chen Ji was struck like lightning, nearly losing his balance. So Chen Tianming's disappearance back then wasn't a simple accident, but rather he voluntarily stepped into that death trap—to divert the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attention from him and Chen Nian. Ten years imprisoned in that chaotic current, fighting indescribable existences with his flesh and blood, all for the sake of letting this worthless younger brother live a few more years."

choice.prompt: "How should Chen Ji choose when faced with the truth that his brother protected him with his life ten years ago?"

choices.description: "Connected by blood, with ten years of his brother's faithful guardianship, this bond requires no doubt. Open all divine consciousness and accept everything from Chen Tianming."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points to establish a soul link"
choices.visible_reward: "Establish deep Blood Pulse resonance with Chen Tianming, sharing partial foresight abilities"
choices.risk_hint: "If Chen Tianming is hiding something, this action will expose all of Chen Ji's trump cards"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, slowly releasing all divine consciousness barriers, allowing that familiar yet foreign energy to flood into his limbs. In an instant, two souls, like rivers reuniting after a long separation, finally merged into the same ocean. Memories poured forth like a breached dam—Chen Tianming's experiences over the past ten years, loneliness, pain, despair, and countless moments of obsession when near death."

choices.description: "Ten years is enough to change too much. Who knows if this isn't another scheme within a scheme? Keep core secrets, only accept necessary information."
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain independent judgment, don't expose trump cards, leaving room for future maneuvering"
choices.risk_hint: "May be detected by Chen Tianming as untrustworthy, affecting subsequent cooperation sincerity"

text.content: "A complex light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, then he firmly locked the core areas of his Mental Sea. He was willing to trust his brother, but ten years of human treachery taught him that trust must have limits. 'Speak, brother,' his voice terrifyingly calm, 'what do you need me to do?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Tianming's voice rang out again, this time with a hint of bitter laughter: 'You still haven't changed, Xiao Ji. You've already believed eight tenths in your heart, but still leave three tenths in words. Truly a Chen family descendant.' After a pause, he continued, 'I don't need you to do anything. I only need you to remember one thing—Chapter 703, the temporal-spatial rift will open a gap, and I will wait for you there.'"

text.content: "These words struck Chen Ji's heart like thunder. Chapter 703—that was the next chapter! His brother could precisely predict chapter transitions? What did this mean? Was this an extension of the Tianji Record's power, or had Chen Tianming comprehended some higher law within the rift? Cold sweat seeped down Chen Ji's back, and even his lingering doubts were replaced by shock."

choice.prompt: "What does Chen Tianming's extraordinary ability to predict chapter transitions signify?"

choices.description: "Since brother dares to come, let's meet. Ten years of separation is long enough. Even if it's a trap, what does Chen Ji have to fear?"
choices.visible_cost: "The risks of entering the temporal-spatial rift are unknown"
choices.visible_reward: "Brothers joining forces doubles combat power, and can obtain key information from Chen Tianming's ten years of comprehension"
choices.risk_hint: "What awaits him in the rift? What exactly is the 'confrontation' Chen Tianming mentioned?"

dialogue.content: "Alright, I'll wait for you. Ten years, brother."

choices.description: "Reunion can happen, but we cannot fight without preparation. Contact Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist to conceal our aura, ensuring absolute certainty."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires additional preparation time, may miss the optimal timing"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain Demonic Path mist cover, significantly reducing the risk of exposure to the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "Uncertainties arise during preparation, and the temporal-spatial rift may close prematurely"

text.content: "Chen Ji suppressed the surging emotions in his chest, his voice cold: 'Reunion is possible, but I need to make some preparations first. Within three days, I will arrive.' The other side of the Mental Sea fell silent for a moment, then a low laugh came through: 'Good, that's the Xiao Ji I know. In three days, at the edge of the rift, I'll be waiting.'"

"The divine consciousness connection slowly faded, Chen Tianming's aura receded like a tide. Before parting, his voice echoed one last time in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: 'Xiao Ji, be careful of Ling Yuan. That old fox... came into contact with the Eye of Heavenly Dao much earlier than we imagined.' As the voice faded, only the echo of Void remained."

dialogue.content: "The guardian of the remnant soul sighed hauntingly: 'It seems my taking you as a disciple all those years ago was indeed fated. Chen Tianming, Chen Nian, and you... the three of you siblings are probably the largest chess game the Eye of Heavenly Dao has orchestrated in ten thousand years.' After a pause, Mo Xiansheng's voice carried gravity: 'Boy, are you truly going to join forces with Tianming?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at the brightening sky beyond the window, a meaningful smile slowly curving his lips. Ling Yuan's cunning face flashed through his mind—so this old fox had never been a protector from the start, but one of the true幕后黑手 behind the scenes. His decade of careful calculations seemed so insignificant before this grander chess game."

choice.prompt: "Now that he knows Ling Yuan's true nature, how should Chen Ji deal with this threat lurking by his side?"

choices.description: "Since we know Ling Yuan is an enemy rather than a friend, there's no need to keep pretending. Catch him off guard and strike first."
choices.visible_reward: "Eliminate the greatest hidden threat, completely grasp Tianqing Sect's话语权"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan is crafty and deep-planning; Chen Ji may not be his match"

text.content: "Chen Ji冷哼一声, fingertips tapping three times on the table, a plan to assassinate Ling Yuan already forming in his mind. Old thing, since you want to be a piece, I'll let you taste what it's like to be checkmated by the pieces themselves."

choices.description: "Startling the enemy is a military taboo. Continue playing the fool, wait until reunited with your brother before making plans."
choices.visible_cost: "Temporarily allow Ling Yuan to grow stronger"
choices.visible_reward: "Protect yourself, wait until the brothers unite to settle accounts"
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan may use this time to lay deeper schemes"

text.content: "Chen Ji收敛起眼中寒芒, donning once more the mask of a cowardly mediocrity. Ten years had been endured; what's a few more days? Once brother emerges, when two '废物' join forces, let's see how long that old fox can laugh."

"Dawn broke in the east, the first rays of morning light spilling through the window onto Chen Ji's face. He slowly opened his eyes, the complex emotions in his gaze gradually replaced by customary indifference. No matter how many hardships lay ahead, he was no longer the child who could only hide behind his brother. The Tianji Record floated quietly in his Mental Sea, the yellowed pages where the characters '天机' seemed several degrees deeper than yesterday."

"Three days later, at the edge of the temporal-spatial rift. He would reunite with his brother after ten years. What fate awaited him then? The tacit understanding of fighting side by side, or another elaborate hoax? Chen Ji didn't know, but he knew one thing—no matter what chess game the Eye of Heavenly Dao had set up, Chen Ji would never be content to be a piece to be moved at will."

"Outside the window came the noisy sounds of Tianqing Sect disciples' morning training, everything as usual, as if that cross-temporal conversation had never occurred. Chen Ji rose and pushed open the window, allowing the cold mountain wind to pour into the room. He gazed toward the distant Main Peak shrouded in clouds and mist, where the leader of Tianqing Sect resided—that outwardly kind old fox Ling Yuan who had long since pledged allegiance to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. A cold, sharp smile curved his lips as Chen Ji murmured to himself: 'See you in three days, brother. This game, we'll flip together.'"
